title: Group E — Check-in / Visit Flow
description: Implement the complete check-in/visit workflow: start visit → add notes/voice memos → reference history → session summary
acceptanceCriteria: User can start a visit by selecting a place (optionally with deal)
User can add text notes during visit
User can record voice memos with hold-to-record interaction
User can view historical timeline of place during visit
Visit session shows summary with duration, voice memos, and photos
Voice memos are stored in browser with IndexedDB
All components follow mobile-first design pattern
